verdict.rationale: Fireworks uses open, portable conventions that make leaving easier: an OpenAI-compatible API and the same SFT data format as OpenAI. It also accepts Hugging Face model uploads, which suggests code and training data aren't locked in. However, nothing in the evidence documents actually exporting your data or trained artifacts out of the platform. Missing for 10: documented export/download of fine-tuned model or LoRA weights, export of datasets, logs and account data, open export formats, and independent confirmation of a clean exit path.
